description: sitmun.diba.cat: drought and low-flow datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sitmun.diba.cat. Coverage: the area served by sitmun.diba.cat. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drought and low-flow; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: TE08000_412 - Vulnerabilidad de los bosques a la sequía moderada; TE08000_411 - Vulnerabilidad de los bosques a la sequía leve; TE08000_413 - Vulnerabilidad de los bosques a la sequía grave. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
